title: Dimensional Variation Analyst
jobDescription:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together. The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: we come together, we always look for a better way, and we create possibilities. Interested in joining us on our journey? Provide a brief description of the general nature of the position; an overview of why the job exists today; and what the job is to accomplish. The job summary should be no more than 3-4 sentences. The Dimensional Variation Analyst is responsible for supporting 3D variation analysis (DVA) requirements as part of GEA's dimensional control strategy to manage and reduce dimensional variation in manufactured products. The ideal candidate will have a sound knowledge of statistical process control, dimensional tolerancing, and root cause analysis. Position Dimensional Variation Analyst Location IND, Bangalore, KA How You'll Create Possibilities Describe the job’s key duties, responsibilities and activities in terms that enable anyone to understand what is required. Avoid using language or acronyms that are organizational-specific. Start by indicating the intended result of the activity. Support the Dimensional Variation Analysis activities on new product designs and facilitate dimensional design optimization, locator verification, and process datum coordination. Support robust application use of GD&T, functional datums and locators. Promote and cultivate a digital-focused culture that leverages the latest digital engineering tools and methods to enhance engineering efficiency. Leverage GEA's Model Based Definition processes to streamline design optimization and lean product development through digital re-use. Support Onshore Team and Engineers with analysis requests and updates. Communicate requirements and observations early and efficiently to help the Product teams. What You'll Bring to Our Team Position Requirement Work with limited domain guidance in cross-functional team environment and onshore DVA team is USA. Proficient in GD&T and able to provide suggestions based on analysis observations and findings. Proficient in making vector loops and performing worse case analysis. Proven ability of problem-solving skills, self-learning abilities and shown track record of technical excellence. Proficient technical communication skills to interact with stakeholders and DVA team.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Must have 3+ years of hands-on experience in using 3DCS software for DVA 5+ years of experience in product design engineering or DVA. Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field.

Strong experience in product design engineering or DVA in consumer products, automotive or other comparable industry. Skilled in using 3DCS software for DVA.
